entries.notes: Glyph form differs: the dictionary closes 氐 with a long horizontal bar (一) while the pinned MM candidate writes a short dot (丶). Strokes 1-9 match, but a bar cannot be derived from the dot's own points without inventing extent; fail closed. The Ja corpus keeps the bar form (祗 in this batch), so a Ja re-pin may recover it later
